title: Evidence of Chemical Reactions
requiredLabVisualSimulationEvidence: Reaction evidence scenario/video/data analysis using observation tables. No unsupervised reactions are required.
simulationVirtualLabReviewRequirement: Required for balancing equations, conservation, mole/stoichiometry, and reaction classification
directSimulationStudentTask: After the simulation opens, use the reaction or molecules screen rather than the sandwich analogy if that screen is available. Set starting reactant amounts, then change only one reactant amount at a time. Observe the products formed and any leftover reactants after the model reaction. Record reactant amounts, product amounts, leftovers, and the ratio or conservation evidence used for Evidence of Chemical Reactions.
simulationReviewImplementation: Student-facing lesson includes one exact direct simulation/resource link plus adjacent step-by-step directions for what to open, click/use, observe, record, and connect to the lesson standard.
simulationSourceReference: ACS resources; OpenStax Chemistry 2e; safe video/data resources
